cited.quote: This Government will also urge the Union Government to increase the permissible man days from 100 to 150

rationale: C3 is a budget speech saying the Government will urge the Union to raise man days from 100 to 150: a statement of intent, not a formal step such as an Assembly resolution, letter or GO. C1, C2 and C5 are routine NREGS sanction GOs that do not touch the 150-day entitlement. Not started.

No extract mentions inclusion of Nari Kuravar, Kuruvikarar, Vettaikarar, Lambadi or Badugar in the Scheduled Tribe list or any request to the Union on it. C1 and C2 describe general tribal welfare and community certificates; C3 concerns reservation quantum, not ST listing.

cited.quote: Aavin has planned to produce these products to improve the sales revenue

rationale: C1 and C2 describe existing marketing network and plans (new products, export efforts, e-commerce in small numbers), which are plans rather than an official technology-upgrade order for production or interstate marketing. C5 is an MGNREGS GO for milk collection centres, a related but different step. No GO or launch for the promise.

cited.quote: Steps will be taken to evolve proper land leasing policy for lands under the Control of Government

rationale: C1 and C2 discuss shrimp farming only in policy-note terms (existing CAA registration, future steps to evolve a leasing policy, studies). No order detailing better management practices for shrimp farming appears. C3 to C5 are about other subjects.

cited.quote: 1,956 shrimp farms are registered under Coastal Aquaculture Authority (CAA) with an extent of 3836.77 ha

rationale: C1 and C2 report existing registration under the Coastal Aquaculture Authority and permission via a District Level Committee, which is the pre-existing regime carrying on. No new regulatory framework or inspection drive for coastal shrimp farms is shown.

cited.quote: Entrepreneurship development programs ennance the self esteem of the students, enable them to learn new things

rationale: C3 is a GO for entrepreneurship training of agricultural college students at TNAU, a different group from the agriculture allied workforce. C5 is a central NFSM order with millet training for farmers, and C1 and C2 are general policy-note schemes. No scheme clearly training and supporting allied workers is shown.

cited.quote: Financial sanction for an amount of Rs.13.535 crore as First Installment accorded

rationale: C4 is a GO (2021-10-22) sanctioning funds under RKVY-RAFTAAR for Agricultural Engineering machinery, with subsidy-based allocation to farmers groups, FPOs and self help groups (C4, C5). This is financial assistance to groups; the fit to allied activity groups is moderate.

cited.quote: Demand No.27 Policy Note 2021-2022 DURAIMURUGAN Minister for Water Resources

rationale: C1 shows Mines and Minerals still functioning as a Directorate under the Industries Department, with a Minister for Water Resources presenting the policy note. C3 to C5 are routine GOs under that department. No extract shows a new Ministry for Mines and Minerals.

No extract concerns the Kollidam stone dam area, the named villages (Visuvanthattai, Vilaangudi, Veeramangudi, Kudithangi, Vaazhkai) or sluice gates. C1, C2, C3 and C5 are about high-level bridges elsewhere, and C4 is about other rehabilitation works.
None of the extracts mentions the Ariyalur-Thanjavur broad gauge rail line. They cover metro rail, a logistics park, a grade separator and buses.

No extract concerns raising reservation for women in government jobs from 30% to 40%. C1, C2 and C4 deal with reservation for other groups or education seats; C3 and C5 are women's schemes without any jobs reservation.

cited.quote: Emergency Care Centres are established for stabilizing the critical cases during long distance transport, especially in highways

rationale: C3 describes 12 existing Emergency Care Centres, all launched on or before 13.02.2021, which predate this government. C1 is undated and describes centres set up in 2002. No new order for centres every 50 km along district highways appears.

cited.quote: Youth Welfare and Sports Development Department dated 05.08.2021 as mentioned below
extended to purchase sports equipment and kits, undergo training abroad, participate in international competitions

rationale: C2 reports a GO dated 05.08.2021 enhancing cash incentives for Olympic and Paralympic medallists: an incentive component. C1 shows training and scholarship schemes, but nothing shows a new specialised training programme across disciplines. So only the incentive part is shown as newly implemented.

cited.quote: New Integrated Bus Stands with modern amenities will be established

rationale: C1 is a policy note stating intent to establish new integrated bus stands. C5 (KNMT guidelines) only lists modern bus stands as a suggestive work for municipalities and town panchayats, and C4 covers rural bus stand facilities. No order or tender for integrated bus stands in major cities is shown.

cited.quote: subsidy will be extended for the purchase of modern jaggery making machineries
permit the sale of Palm Jaggery through select Fair Price Shops run by Cooperatives

rationale: C1 is a budget announcement of training and machinery subsidy, which is only a plan. C2 and C5 are a GO allowing sale of palm jaggery through fair price shops, which is marketing, not a loan scheme or technology facility for producers. C3 shows existing infrastructure support. No loan scheme or machinery order is shown.
No extract mentions property tax or any decision to hold or hike it. C1 and C2 concern GST and commercial taxes, C4 a vehicle tax extension, and C5 a tourism committee.

cited.quote: requisites and claims of Ex-Servicemen and dependents are being catered through 30 District offices

rationale: C1 and C2 describe the existing Directorate of Ex-Servicemen's Welfare and its funds and schemes. No extract shows a new committee created to address grievances of ex-army personnel and families.

cited.quote: encouraged to install Micro Irrigation System availing the full Government subsidy

rationale: C3 and C4 describe existing micro irrigation assistance (full subsidy in project areas; 100% for small and marginal and 75% for others under PMKSY for sugarcane). No order giving 90% drip irrigation subsidy for up to 5 acres appears; C1, C2 and C5 cover other subsidies.

cited.quote: continuously urge the Government of India to bring an amendment to the Constitution of India

rationale: C1 is a policy note saying the Government will urge the Union to amend the Constitution so states can fix reservation quantum. This is a statement of intent, not a formal step such as an Assembly resolution, a letter or a GO. C2 and C3 concern state-level roster and election reservations.

No extract concerns withdrawing cases against protesting employees. C1 deals with disciplinary and suspension case pendency in one office inspection, and the others are about labour rules, vigilance and court statistics.
